triggers: Consequential state, storage, security, and migration decisions
Synthesis of a prior system design with superseding requirements
Creation of an implementation-ready standalone repository plan
reasoning_heavy_assessment.justification: The target has changed from a repository-local wrapper to a global standalone system shared by Codex and Claude Code, with all code and durable state under a synchronized Windows directory. This requires a focused independent architecture delta before implementation.

title: Convert the Web Call Assistant into a global standalone Codex and Claude Code system
objective: Revise the prior candidate architecture into a precise, implementation-ready standalone product whose entire codebase, global state, project registry, exchange evidence, extension, companion, documentation, tests, and installers live under C:\Users\sinas\OneDrive\Desktop\Projects\GptWebCall and which any Codex or Claude Code session can invoke by reading one canonical Markdown protocol file.

in_scope: Treat GLOBAL_REQUIREMENTS.md as binding and explicitly reconcile every prior-design assumption that it changes.
Define the exact standalone repository layout under the canonical root, with clear ownership for every top-level directory and important file.
Define a single canonical client-neutral WEB_CALL_PROTOCOL.md that can be referenced from any Codex or Claude Code session.
Define minimal Codex and Claude Code adapter instructions without duplicating the core protocol or state.
Design the global project registry, external-project registration, approved-root policy, context snapshotting, multi-project isolation, call lineage, and explicit integration boundary.
Preserve the deterministic timestamped JSON/folder evidence model while locating all new calls and state under the standalone root.
Resolve the global SQLite/filesystem/event-store architecture under OneDrive, including locking, WAL/sync behavior, conflict detection, backups, restore, crash recovery, and host assumptions.

Specify exact CLI commands and machine-readable contracts that Codex and Claude Code will use to classify, register, prepare, authorize, collect, validate, accept, integrate, resume, and inspect work.
Specify how the Chrome extension and native host discover and communicate with the standalone installation without repository-local dependencies.
Provide a migration strategy that imports or indexes legacy F1D exchanges read-only without rewriting them.
Produce a dependency-ordered implementation plan with TDD, exact files, verification gates, and a smallest coherent global vertical slice.
Research current official Codex, Claude Code, Chrome, Windows/OneDrive, SQLite, and filesystem constraints only where needed to support time-sensitive claims.
out_of_scope: Writing implementation code in this Web call
Requiring infrastructure inside F1D or another external project
Duplicating global operational state separately for Codex and Claude Code
Automatic ChatGPT Send, response scraping, private endpoints, cookie/session access, or automatic/programmatic Output extraction
Claiming that a OneDrive-synchronized database is safe without a concrete operating model and recovery controls
